form.intro: Write your method down clearly: the knowbot's logic comes only from what you write. Where something is missing we will ask you rather than fill it in.
form.title: Name

q.steps: What are the steps, and which rule decides each step?
q.outputs: What does the output look like?
q.correctness: How do you know it is right?

form.casesHint: Give a few examples whose answers you know: what to ask, and what an item in the result should be. Only you can fill in the expected values (for example, figures you looked up in an annual report); we do not fill them in for you. Testing checks that it runs correctly, not the method itself.
form.question: Case {n}: what to ask
form.consent: I agree that the materials I choose in knowbase for testing may be used to test this knowbot. Tests run on my own computer with my own model key. The write-ups and step results are shown only to me; when I ask the platform to test or review it, they are also shown to the platform staff doing that work, to check the knowbot works correctly. They are not used for training, not shown to other users and not used for anything else. They are deleted 90 days after the candidate is listed or replaced by a newer one.
form.invalid: Something did not pass the checks. Please make sure every field is filled in and numbers are valid.
form.failed: Could not submit. Please try again later.
form.questionText: What question should the expert answer
form.questionHint: One sentence is enough: AI drafts the method from it, and you revise and settle it.

knowbotQuestions.title: Questions for you
knowbotQuestions.intro: The test stopped where it needs your decision: this is a judgement in your method, so only you can answer. The test continues once you answer, and your answer goes into the next candidate.
knowbotQuestions.failed: Could not submit. Please try again.
knowbotQuestions.approvalIntro: The test wants to do this on your computer: it happens only if you approve; if you deny, the step does not do it.
knowbotQuestions.dataHere: Confirm the data the expert asks for under “Testing” on the name page.
knowbotQuestions.gapWhere: A gap listed by AI incubation: a judgement in your method that only you can make.

result.question: You asked: {question}
result.noReason: What this step returned did not meet the requirements.

outputs.omitted: This step's result was too large ({bytes} bytes) to bring back.

consent.needed: This idea was submitted under the old test-data notice. Accept the new notice to see the write-ups and step results of its tests.
consent.text: New notice: the write-ups and step results of a test are shown only to you and to the staff running the test — you use them to accept the knowbot, the staff to check it works correctly. They are not used for training, not shown to other users and not used for anything else. They are deleted 90 days after the candidate is listed or replaced by a newer one.
consent.failed: That did not work; please try again later.
consent.hidden: This idea has not accepted the new test-data notice, so write-ups and step results are hidden for now. Accept it under Applications.

categories.accepted: Accepted by you, waiting for our review

expertStage.to_review: accepted by you, waiting for our review

applications.title: Applications
applications.intro: The methods and acceptance cases you handed in. Each change makes a new version under the same name; once we accept it we incubate and test it, and what passes is an expert that belongs only to you.
applications.pending: Idea v{version} is in; waiting for us to accept it.
applications.accepted: Idea v{version} is accepted: we incubate and test from it, and anything we need from you shows up in Review.
applications.rejected: Idea v{version} was not accepted: {reason}. Change it and hand it in again as a new version.
applications.reviseHint: A revision is a new version; old versions stay, and a test already running is not affected.
applications.reviseFrom: “{title}”: start from idea v{version}; handing it in makes a new version.

review.title: Review
review.intro: Everything waiting for you: questions from tests, candidates to review, and whether to take the version that passed.
review.empty: Nothing waiting for you in this category.
review.draftHint: This candidate was written from your method. Check each rule is what you meant: if so, press Fine; if not, say what is wrong and we will incubate again.
review.failed: Could not submit. Please try again.
review.expertHint: This version passed its test. Read the write-ups and results below: take it and, once we review it, it is listed and you can ask it in the knowbench workbench; decline and this version is not listed.

experts.title: Experts
experts.intro: The versions that passed and were returned to you; they belong only to you. Those you took and we reviewed can be asked in the knowbench workbench.
experts.empty: No expert has been returned to you yet.
experts.hint: Ask it in the knowbench workbench: look for “{name}” when choosing an expert.
experts.trial: This version was listed in the trial period (before the two gates existed).
experts.stopFailed: Could not stop it. Please try again later.

now.to_return: It passed; once it is returned to you, decide in Review.
now.awaiting_user: It passed; waiting for you to decide whether to take this version.
now.declined: You declined this version; it is not listed.
now.to_review: You took it; waiting for our review. Once reviewed you can ask it.
now.rejected: It did not pass our review and is not listed: {reason}

name.title: Name
name.intro: The life of one name: the latest of each process, and the record in time order.
name.incubationHint: Write your method step by step in cells; it saves itself. When it is ready, publish a draft expert and test it.
name.published: Published draft expert {label}: you can test it yourself under “Testing” below.

workdraft.title: Workdraft
workdraft.intro: Write your method step by step in cells. It saves itself; press “Publish a version” to make a draft expert you can test.
workdraft.loadFailed: Could not load; refresh and try again.

status.failed: Not saved ({code}); change anything to retry.

workdraft.conflict: It was changed elsewhere and has been reloaded.

data.title: Data
data.hint: Picking data from your knowbase comes later; picked ids are listed here.

step.title: What this step is called
step.doesHint: A sentence or two; say here what data this step usually needs.
step.whyHint: Shown to the user while the expert works.
step.usesNone: This is the first step; nothing comes before it.
step.ask: Ask the user before the step
step.question: Question {n}
step.items: Fields of each entry in item {n}
step.nameInvalid: Names cannot be empty or contain spaces, dots, slashes, quotes or punctuation.
step.notSaved: These items are not saved until they are fixed.
step.checks: How to tell it is right
step.checksHint: Every returned item is required automatically; “returns one JSON” and “no trading advice” need no entry.
step.advancedHint: Left alone it uses the defaults: every tool, the default budget and input limit.
step.ownSchema: This step uses a hand-written output structure (brought in by an import).

onFail.rework: Redo once, then stop and ask
onFail.back: Go back to an earlier step

templates.each_has: Every entry has fields / a field takes only some values

templates.computed: Numbers come from the compute tool
templates.covers: Covers every entry of an earlier step

problems.title: To fix before publishing
problems.noSource: No source: change this cell yourself and it counts as yours.
problems.differs: This cell differs from its record: change it yourself and it counts as yours.
problems.noOutputs: Add at least one returned item.
problems.backEarlier: Only an earlier step can be gone back to.
problems.usesEarlier: Only earlier steps can be used.

preview.none: Everything holds; you can publish a version.

import.title: Import an expert pack
import.hint: Paste a manifest v2 JSON or choose a file. Importing replaces the whole workdraft; what you import counts as your own words, so import only your own files.
import.invalid: This manifest cannot be imported: only manifest v2 ({code}).
import.skillHint: Paste a skill or choose a file: it is saved as a new version of your idea (kind skill); the workdraft stays as it is. Then click “AI draft” to have AI break it into steps, or write them yourself from it.
import.seedSubmit: Save as a new idea version
import.seeded: Saved as version {version} of your idea. Click “AI draft” to have AI draft from it, or write from it yourself.
import.seedFailed: Could not save ({code}). Please try again.

copy.title: Copy from my draft experts
copy.hint: Start from one of your draft experts under this name; the whole workdraft is replaced.
copy.label: Draft expert
copy.none: No draft experts under this name yet.

ai.label: AI suggestion
ai.unverified: The source does not check out: it claims to come from your words or answers, but does not match. You can only accept it after editing (edited text counts as your own words).
ai.fromProposal: This is an AI proposal: it counts only once you accept it.
ai.fromIdea: From your own words in the idea: “{quote}”
ai.draftHint: AI drafts the skeleton from your idea: the steps, what each does, what it hands back. Judgements that are yours to make (definitions, thresholds, forecasting methods, what counts as right) come only as gaps with a proposal, never written into cells. Suggestions enter the draft only when you accept them.
ai.reviseHint: Say in one line what to change, optionally for one step. AI takes your current workdraft and answered gaps and hands back suggestions; judgements come back as gaps.
ai.noComputer: You have not connected a computer yet: connect one in knowbench first.
ai.keyNote: Runs on your computer with your model key, at your cost; it stops at the limit.

errors.incubation_running: A round of this workdraft is already running: wait for it to finish or cancel it.
errors.incubation_unconfigured: AI incubation is not available yet. Please try again later.

ai.startFailed: Could not start. Please try again.
ai.gapsHint: These are judgements in your method: AI only asks and proposes, you decide. Answer them under Review (you can answer “as proposed”); then write the answer into the cells yourself, or click “Ask AI to change…” to take your answers along.
ai.reviseWithAnswers: Ask AI to change by my answers…
ai.started: Round {n} started: its suggestions will show next to the cells.
ai.cancelFailed: Could not cancel ({code}). Please try again.
